note: The four default tracks every visitor starts with. To use a real track, put the audio file in this folder (web/tracks/) and set its "file", e.g. "tracks/nightfall.mp3", and its "name" (shown in the HUD, keep it short). With no file, the slot plays a synthesized placeholder made from "synth". A visitor's own dropped track replaces a slot in their browser only; RESTORE DEFAULT brings this one back.
